items.name: Seed Shop
items.whyItMatters: Main route for buying crops; common seeds restock faster while higher-rarity plants take longer.

items.name: Gears Shop
items.sells: Watering cans, sprinklers, mushrooms, tools, defensive gear
items.whyItMatters: Core shop for growth boosts, mutation support, night visibility, and garden defense.

items.name: Props Shop
items.sells: Crates with props, structures, utilities, and defensive items
items.whyItMatters: Main source for crates used to decorate, fortify, and block gardens against stealing.

items.name: Lobby Pet Spawns
items.whyItMatters: Pets are bought when they spawn, can be outbid by other players, and disappear after their timer.

items.name: Guilds Counter
items.sells: Guild creation and guild management access
items.whyItMatters: Creating a guild costs 99 Robux; rewards are not revealed yet.
